[F-001] Independently deployable Buyer, Seller, and Marketplace shells
issues.reviewer: Blake Rowley (interim; split when a second human joins)

tests.success: a clean install, tests, and independent builds pass; each protected preview health route returns the correct domain and exact commit.
tests.failure: a missing or unknown domain, or a forbidden cross-console import, fails before deploy without exposing secrets.
tests.recovery: redeploy the immediately prior verified preview for the affected console and confirm all three health routes pass.

issues.rollout: protected Buyer, Seller, and Marketplace previews; no customer traffic.
issues.rollback: redeploy the immediately prior verified preview for only the affected console.
issues.telemetry: domain_deployment_health_result with domain, commit, environment, assertion, result, and timestamp; no user data or secrets.
issues.proof: reports/evidence/r0-three-domain-foundation.json plus three linked preview health receipts.
issues.outcome: Make Buyer, Seller, and Marketplace three independently deployable application shells that share only approved cross-domain packages.

issues.title: [F-004] Reproducible application foundation
issues.reviewer: Blake Rowley (interim; split when a second human joins)

tests.success: clean install, typecheck, test, build, staging deploy, and health request pass for the same commit.
tests.failure: missing required environment input fails before deploy and emits no secret values.
tests.recovery: rollback redeploys the prior commit and the health request passes against that commit.

issues.rollout: staging canary only; no customer traffic.
issues.rollback: redeploy the immediately prior verified commit.
issues.telemetry: deployment_health_check_result with commit, environment, assertion, result, and timestamp; no secrets.
issues.proof: * `reports/evidence/r0-foundation.json` plus the linked staging deployment receipt.

issues.title: [F-005] Typed Convex Preview foundation and reactive proof

tests.success: clean install, Convex code generation, typecheck, tests, all three production builds, a commit-bound Preview deployment, and the transactional/reactive probe pass within the §7.5.3 SLO.
tests.failure: a missing or malformed key or URL, production target, polling, stale generated client, or secret-bearing payload fails before deploy without exposing secrets.
tests.recovery: redeploy the prior verified commit to the same Preview deployment, rerun the probe, then restore and re-prove the latest verified commit.

issues.rollout: named Convex Preview deployment only; no production traffic or customer data.
issues.rollback: redeploy the immediately prior verified Git commit to the same Preview deployment, rerun the probe, then restore the latest verified commit.
issues.telemetry: convex_foundation_health_result with deployment reference, commit, environment, observation latency, assertion, result, and timestamp; no key or probe payload.
issues.proof: reports/evidence/r0-convex-foundation.json plus commit-bound deployment, transactional/reactive probe, rollback, restore, and CI receipts.
issues.outcome: Provision a typed Convex Preview backend used by all three app shells, with a synthetic zero-customer-data transactional and reactive health probe.
